clips.title: The story
paras: Leaders of the Fang is a pivotal Horde quest tasked by Nara Wildmane from the heights of Thunder Bluff. It directs adventurers into the Wailing Caverns to strike down the four leaders of the corrupted Druids of the Fang and retrieve their twisted dream gems. Halting these rogue druids is essential to preventing their serpentine nightmare from permanently overtaking the Barrens.

The night elf druid Naralex ventured into the subterranean springs of the Wailing Caverns with a selfless ambition: to use the Emerald Dream to restore lush vitality to the arid Barrens. Tragically, when his slumber took root, his dream turned into a waking nightmare. The acolytes who accompanied him lost their devotion to nature's harmony, succumbing to the nightmare's corruption and adopting the mantle of the Druids of the Fang.

To reshape the Barrens into their own viperous Eden, the leaders of the splintered sect channel the warped dream energies through specialized foci known as dream gems. Lord Cobrahn, Lady Anacondra, Lord Pythas, and Lord Serpentis each bear one of these gems. As long as these artifacts remain in their grasp, their corrupting influence will seep outward into the soil and waters of Kalimdor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The druids in the Wailing Caverns, the Druids of the Fang, are an aberration. They were part of an order of noble druids whose plan was to heal the Barrens, but now seek to remake that land to match their own, twisted dreams.
The Druids of the Fang have four leaders, and each possesses a dream gem. Even now their faces haunt me! Defeat the leaders and bring me their gems, and the Barrens may again know peace.
Go, friend. You will find them lurking deep within the Wailing Caverns.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Memories of my nightmares haunt me, friend. Have you defeated the leaders of the fang and acquired their gems?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done it, friend. You killed the leaders of the Druids of the Fang. My dreams are now free of their wicked faces, and you have helped save the Barrens from a cursed future.
I thank you, friend. I thank you for myself, for the druids of Thunder Bluff, and for the land.
